description: This file declares the `em_cmd_scan_channel_t` class, which is responsible for initiating a Wi-Fi channel scan in a mesh network. It extends the `em_cmd_t` base class and provides a constructor that takes scan parameters and a reference to a mesh structure to perform the scan operation.

classes.name: em_cmd_scan_channel_t
classes.description: A class representing a command to scan a specific Wi-Fi channel in a mesh network. It holds the parameters for the scan and the mesh structure to be updated.

methods.name: em_cmd_scan_channel_t
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the scan command with specified parameters and the mesh structure.
